news.title: Choksi Laboratories Limited Announces Resignation of Non- Executive Independent Director, Member of the Audit Committee and Nomination & Remuneration Committee (Chairperson), Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Choksi Laboratories Limited announced that Mrs. Meenaxi Patidar (DIN: 10206356), vide her email dated 09th January, 2026 has tendered her resignation from the position of Non- Executive Independent Director of the Company with effect from January 09th, 2026 due to preoccupation and personal commitments. Consequently, she shall also cease to be a Member of the Audit Committee and Nomination & Remuneration Committee (Chairperson).

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.8% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent.
